title: Quasi-affineness occurs at a finite stage of an affine inverse limit
statement: Let $I$ be a small nonempty directed set [def-weil-size-convention] and $(Y_i)_{i\in I}$ an inverse system of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with affine transition morphisms [pqf-def-affine-morphism]. Suppose $Y\cong\varprojlim_iY_i$ and $Y$ is quasi-affine, meaning isomorphic to a quasi-compact open subscheme of an affine scheme. Then there exists $i\in I$ such that $Y_i$ is quasi-affine.
